text_block_list.text:
On a day off, I spotted Almond Eye pushing herself
in some self-directed training on the riverbank.
choice_data_list: (So much sweat... Is she in her final push phase?)
(So much sweat... Is she in her final push phase?)

text_block_list.text: Even so, figure she'd be taking a break soon, I was about to just walk on past, but—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...N-Next. Medium interval run.
1,200m, 20 reps, 30 seconds rest...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
The break was too short, you say?
However...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"50% of your sprint duration."
That's the fundamental baseline for recovery――for rest time, correct?
choice_data_list: Yeah. But in a paper I happened to read recently...

text_block_list.text: Saying that, I briefly explained the contents of the paper.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
! Such a theory exists...?
To think it reduces physical strain while boosting efficiency...
choice_data_list: Right. That's why we need to make sure to take proper breaks.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Right, understood.
...Still, you have an incredible amount of knowledge.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I read research papers regularly. But as for going through
every single recent publication from cover to cover...
choice_data_list: If it's an Umamusume, I think that's plenty.

text_block_list.text:
Knowledge beyond textbooks is the trainer's domain.
There is no need for an Umamusume to go so far as reading academic papers.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ――Even so.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Still, I refuse.
Leaving things like this... I absolutely won't accept it.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: That is why, first of all, I will surpass you!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yes, you.
First, I will study more than you do!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
And I will become one!
An Umamusume second to none in knowledge, too!
choice_data_list: Even when studying, taking moderate breaks is important.
Even when studying, taking moderate breaks is important.
I'd better study hard so I don't fall behind.
I can't lose to them; I need to study too.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
And I will become one!
An Umamusume second to none in knowledge, too!
choice_data_list: Even when studying, taking moderate breaks is important.
Even when studying, taking moderate breaks is important.
I'd better study hard so I don't fall behind.
I can't lose to them; I need to study too.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course!
...Or so I'd like to say, but.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, I kind of feel like
resting means admitting defeat...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I wonder how everyone else finds a balance?
It's such a tricky spot to be in.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Fufu. That makes us wonderful rivals, then!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Let us both give it our absolute best.
—Because I have no intention of losing!
